_comment: Third-party API bridges. When a Fabric API method is renamed between versions, add its entry
here and Fox-Grade will rewrite call sites in the ported mod's bytecode to the new name.
Pure renames only (same signature, same return type). For argument-type or return-type changes,
a synthetic shim class is required — future work. Add such entries under a separate `shims`
Grow this table the same way rules.json grows — from real failures observed in ported mods.
